categories.main_business_segments: Starzen Company Limited operates primarily in the meat-related business, which includes the processing and sale of meat, production and sale of ham, sausages, and processed meat products, as well as the breeding and fattening of pigs and cattle. The group also engages in supporting businesses such as logistics and food ingredient manufacturing through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced meat processing and packaging technologies, including vacuum and skin-packaging for shelf-life extension, and has invested in process automation and digital transformation (DX) for logistics and sales. It also conducts R&D in embryo transfer for cattle breeding and continuously improves its hamburger patty processing and additive reduction techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Starzen serves a wide range of customers including major retailers, supermarkets, convenience stores, food service chains, and food manufacturers. Its end markets are primarily in Japan, but it is expanding exports of Japanese Wagyu and Australian Wagyu to overseas markets such as China, Southeast Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, with a nationwide network of processing, manufacturing, and logistics facilities. It also has subsidiaries and affiliates in Australia, the United States, Europe, and China, supporting both import/export and local production activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Starzen operates across the entire meat supply chain, from upstream (breeding and fattening livestock), through midstream (processing and manufacturing), to downstream (wholesale distribution and logistics), positioning itself as an integrated meat supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the domestic and international supply chain, expanding overseas business (especially exports of Wagyu), developing high value-added and differentiated products, and advancing sustainability initiatives such as GHG reduction and animal welfare. R&D focuses on breeding technologies, product innovation, and digital transformation of operations.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of meat, processed meat products, and related food items to B2B customers. Additional revenue streams include logistics services and, to a lesser extent, licensing and support services for group companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Starzen is one of Japan’s leading integrated meat companies, competing with other major domestic meat processors and distributors such as NH Foods and Itoham Yonekyu. It differentiates itself through its end-to-end supply chain, strong export capabilities, and focus on high-value Wagyu products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 436.1 billion yen, with net income attributable to parent company shareholders of 12.2 billion yen. The company has shown steady revenue growth over the past five years, with a notable increase in net profit in the latest year due to asset sales and improved export performance.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Starzen emphasizes the stable supply of safe, high-quality meat products, leveraging its integrated supply chain and expertise in both domestic and imported meats. Its unique value lies in its ability to offer premium Wagyu and Australian Wagyu globally, respond flexibly to diverse customer needs, and pursue sustainability and food safety as core differentiators.
